name: coach-core-rules-tests
description: Firestore and Storage security-rules tests. Runs ONLY against the local Firebase Emulator Suite with a demo-* project ID.

scripts.test: cd ../.. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-coach-core-beta --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix tests/rules run test:unit"
scripts.test:unit: ANNOTATE_LABEL='Rules emulator' node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=../../.github/scripts/annotate-reporter.mjs --test-reporter-destination=stdout firestore.rules.test.mjs storage.rules.test.mjs persistence.rules.test.mjs
